protocol.hypothesis: Nearby breakout and exit windows may reduce whipsaw while retaining monthly returns; test the full grid, not only the best historical ticker.

corporate_actions.note: Only SFIN cash dividends were verified for a separate sensitivity run. Other symbols and event types remain unverified.

protocol.universe: Every TQBR SECID in data/candles/moex_scan/universe_2026-10-30.json with evaluable 1D and 1H candles; the same non-return-selected symbols on all three frames
protocol.grid_constraint: exit_length < entry_length; 19 Turtle pairs plus baseline
protocol.baseline: buy and hold 25% of each independent 1m RUB account from first evaluable open
protocol.signal_rule: Close-confirmed breakout above prior entry_length highs / below prior entry_length lows; exit long below prior exit_length lows / short above prior exit_length highs; all windows exclude current bar and fill at next open
protocol.cost_status: after_30bps_round_trip_transaction_cost_equivalent; excludes dividends, corporate actions, short borrow and exchange lots
protocol.monthly_regime: ex post only: monthly market return >5% growth, <-5% decline, else sideways if high-low range <=10% of first open, otherwise volatile_mixed
protocol.selection: retain all outcomes and compare neighboring windows, monthly PnL and control; no automatic approval or paper-trading switch

walk_forward.selector: For each timeframe choose one global parameter pair on every symbol with complete training months; rank by median per-symbol profitable-month share, then median per-symbol mean monthly return, then median per-symbol worst month PnL. Test on available complete test months without retuning.
walk_forward.neighbor_rule: Entry or exit length adjacent in the ordered grid while other length stays fixed and exit < entry; report train and test differences for every neighbor.
walk_forward.stress_scope: same complete-history symbols; all unique fold-selected pairs per timeframe plus 20/10 and 55/20
walk_forward.future_blind_holdout: new completed bars after 2026-11-04 only; pending, not represented by 2026_ytd

limitations: intraday windows count bars, not trading days
25% position size differs from current 10% paper setup
historical fills use next open while paper runner fills at the next observed completed close
transaction slippage modeled as cash-cost equivalent, not fill-price shift
no exchange lots or short borrow
dividends and corporate actions not modeled

validation.note: DATA_READY confirms data and report gates only; it does not approve a trading strategy.
